test_title: PYST 8: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. 

Eighty rupees are / too much for / this leather bag, / which is looking so old.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Eighty rupees are**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When we use currency as a whole we use the **singular form** of **verb** even if the **currency** is **plural**,
 
• In the above question '**are**' should be replaced with '**is**' 

So, the correct sentence would be '**Eighty rupees is too much for this leather bag, which is looking so old **'.
